richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bongaigaon

c: Bongaigaon is in lower Assam, on the main road and rail route into upper Assam, and it is home to a refinery township as well as railway and government colonies. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bongaigaon to townships, schools, colleges, industrial campuses, and municipal parks. At about 1,970 km, it is one of the farthest towns we deliver to from our Vasai factory.

Because the distance is long, we prefer to get the details right before anything is made. Send photos of the site, its size and the type of ground, and we will confirm the machines and the installation method on the layout drawing. Rain is the main factor here. The monsoon is long and heavy, humidity stays high, and grounds can stay soft for weeks. Grouted footings, a raised base and galvanised frames are the safe choice for this climate.
On wet ground, raise the gym area slightly and slope it so water drains off. Machines with sealed moving parts and plastic seats dry quickly after a shower. The
give younger users strength work. Wipe the seats before use in the monsoon, and clear moss or algae from the base when it appears.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you really deliver outdoor gym equipment to lower Assam?
items.a: Yes. We send the machines by road from Vasai, and our installation team or a dealer covering the north-east sets them up. We confirm all details before manufacture.

items.q: Will constant rain damage the machines?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the seats are roto-moulded plastic, so they do not rust or rot. Keep drains clear and check bolts after the monsoon.

items.q: Who handles after-sales service so far from your factory?
items.a: Contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. We arrange spares and repairs through our team or the dealer who installed the gym.
